tips: | If you can bait her to W, and you manage to hide behind the minion wave, you can look to E yourself, then W her, into R-Q.
| If he misses his Q on you, you can look to E yourself, W, into R-Q.
| Should be able to bully him around. Depends on who his lane partner is.

| He can't really do anything to you, but just be aware that if you R-Q him, and he shields it, you will not get any Mantra cooldown back (because it blocks 100% of the damage of the first thing that hits it)

| His threat level varies, depending on which guns he has. Green gun makes him hard to reach, Red/White gun is easy to poke, but can't all-in him, Purple Gun means he can probably root you and walk away. Blue Gun is where you'll want to fight him.
| As long as you can W him first just before he W-Q's you, you'll likely win the all-in, especially if you have Bone Plating up.
| Really depends on his support.
| Pretty easy to deal with. Just don't W him until AFTER his E is on cooldown, OR, until you're almost in Melee Range, THEN W him, and even if he E's, you can still root him.

| She's got a decent amount of range, which makes her not stand close enough to the minions, which makes her harder to poke. Only opportunity is to R-Q her, E yourself, but you have to side-step her net (E) after you W her.

| No ways to stop his engage, and he can peel off Bone Plating pretty easily. Galio also tends to take Nimbus Cloak too, so its really hard to find windows to punish him. This may be one of the few times to go Relic Shield over Spellthiefs.
| While it will be harder to kill her, she has almost no opportunities to kill you, so you can just bully her out of lane.
| Depends on what runes/item he starts. The more movement speed he has (Shoes, Fleet of Footwork), the harder he will to hit, so it may be better to aim at his support instead.
| Low mobility, easy to punish. Just don't step on the chompers.
| Just be careful of being bursted down if you decide to try and hold her down with W + E. Her W + Passive damage is still very high. Otherwise pretty easy to deal with.
| Depends on how good they are. Hitting her with Q might be difficult.
| play around his W cooldown. If he doesn't have it up, his damage is significantly lower, and you can look to punish it, with E-W.
| Shouldn't be too bad if you take Unflinching with Exhaust. But still pretty annoying to deal with.
| Depending on how aggressive they play. Since he'll be standing relatively close to the ranged minions, Q's should be easy. Its more so his burst than can be a problem.
| Relatively easy to deal with. Just try not to run directly at her.
| Hard to get close to do much, and can get really oppressively quickly.
| Trading Shield to out-run the saplings, you'll usually end up on the winning side of this.
| Pretty much untouchable. Black Shield prevents the root from going through and even her ult, she wants to tether you back.
| Pretty skill based match-up. But in the long run, she will beat you since she heals and Karma does not.
| His hook range is farther than your W cast range, and its quite difficult to deal with. This may be one of the few times to go Relic Shield over Spellthiefs.
| Pretty much can't hold him down. He has too much mobility. Personally would ban this or Nautilus.

| This depends on his lane partner. If he's got a lane partner who synergizes well with his E, it'll make dodging his W much harder. And once he has ult, he will be quite hard to deal with in team fights.
| Laning phase should be pretty easy. If her Q is on cooldown, you can just run at her.
| If you can survive her initial All-In, with Unflinching and Bone Plating, you should be able to turn it around with R-W. Her Q does break shields as well, so just keep it in mind.
| Depends on her support, but hitting her with Q's should be pretty easy, I wouldn't aim R-Qs at her after she hits level 3 (because of her W)

| Shes super squishy, and there's multiple options to punish her. You can either E yourself to W her, or if you land R-Q or just Q, you can W her. She has no escapes, and even better your W reveals her in her E.
| Kind of hard to get close and without R-Q, its hard to get anything done. But very easily punished if she walks too close.
| Easy to punish, but she will out-scale you as she just provides so much to her team. You have to punish her weak early game.
| Focus more on dodging her Q, than landing your own Q, and you should win this lane. If you get hit by any of her Q's, you will quickly start losing the 2v2 however.
| Skill match-up. If you walk into his E range, you're likely in trouble. While trying to W him, just be careful not to get too close to get E-ed by him.
| Very hard to deal with, her jump range is huge, and on top of that, she can likely reset it to jump again, before your W on her goes off. Consider taking exhaust vs her.
| There's so little he can do to you. Only need to respect his Flash Stun. Otherwise, free lane.
| Easy to punish. Just once he's level 6, the lane is hard to play.
| Easy to poke, but hard to all-in her, since she can push you away.
| It really depends on how much his jungler will camp you. Otherwise, not too difficult in a strict 2v2, until he's level 6. Then he can usually burst you with his lane partner.
| Dodge skill shots. Land skill shots. Going even in this lane is winning the lane, since Karma will provide more to the team than Velkoz.

| If you try to fight her, you can't run directly at her since if she's auto-ing you back as you run at her, all her feathers will end up behind you for her E. So you have to walk at an angle at her, while making sure to side step her Q as well.
| Dodge skill shots. Land skill shots. Going even in this lane is winning the lane, since Karma will provide more to the team than Xerath.
| Can't W her. hard to mitigate what she does. Depends on who your lane partner is, but still not a favorable matchup.
| Easy lane
| Good laning phase until hes level 6. After that you can't kill him anymore unless he really screws up.
| If she has a lot of seeds behind/around her, it'll be hard to engage, but if she only has W seeds, you have more options to try and all-in her.
| A skill match-up, but if you manage to W her before she puts her spellshield up, she cannot spellshield the rooting effect itself. Avoid using R-Q at her if she has spellshield ready.
| Good poke and lots of uptime to run people down with slows.
| Doesn't work too well with hyper carries, need early game bullies.
| Good poke, but definitely better options.
| Lots of early laning power and snowball potential.
| Enemies stand behind minions to not get hit by his Q. Karma wants enemies to stand behind/beside minions. Excellent poke, and helps ezreal push waves.
| Doesn't work too well with hyper carries, need early game bullies.
| Some early game burst potential, but since you can't help stack her passive, there's better options.
| Lots of early laning power and snowball potential.
| Doesn't work too well with hyper carries, need early game bullies.
| Lots of early laning power and snowball potential.
| Good poke, but definitely better options.
| Can't set her up for much.
| Lots of pushing power and you can set him up pretty good. He's not quite a lane bully, but definitely a decent lane partner.
| Not a lot going on here.
| Not a lot going on here.
| Lots of early laning power and snowball potential.
| Good poke, but definitely better options.
| Doesn't work too well with hyper carries, need early game bullies.
| She may have some synergy because of Karma's shield, but Zeri's early laning is very weak, and is best paired with lane bullies. But once laning phase ends, Karma with Zeri is very good.
